Bug Description: Timing detail columns (DNS / TCP / TTFB / Duration) missing in details table — only URL column renders
Root Cause: Panel table renderer not outputting timing columns from resourceTiming data
Fix Required: Add DNS / TCP / TTFB / Duration columns to the AUD-001 detail table in audits.js / panel.js

Bug Description: First-party CDN assets (e.g. static.files.bbci.co.uk) included in third-party library count inflating the number
Root Cause: Filter logic checks for any cross-origin resource instead of truly external vendor domains
Fix Required: Tighten the third-party filter to exclude subdomains of the current site's registered domain (e.g. use tldts or manual eTLD+1 comparison)

Bug Description: Third-party vendor cookies (Permutive / Chartbeat / Piano / Optimizely / Google Ads) misclassified as first-party — audit reports 0 third-party tracking (false PASS)
Root Cause: Classification logic uses cookie domain ownership only; BBC server-side tagging sets all vendor cookies on .bbc.com so they appear first-party
Fix Required: Add a cookie name pattern allowlist (known vendor cookie names: _cb _cb_svref permutive-id __gads __gpi __eoi cX_P cX_G pa_vid _pprv _pcid _pctx _chartbeat2 optimizelyEndUserId etc.) to override domain-based classification

Bug Description: Consent cookies (e.g. ckns_policy) classified as first-party instead of consent category
Root Cause: consent cookie name patterns not matched against BBC CMP cookie names
Fix Required: Extend consent cookie name list to include ckns_policy and other CMP variants

Bug Description: Clicking Clear then re-running without page reload gives false PASS — consent violation evidence wiped from buffer
Root Cause: Audit only checks requests captured since last page load; Clear wipes the buffer so nothing to detect
Fix Required: Add warning prompt when Clear is clicked during consent-denied session OR persist consent-related request captures separately until page reload

Bug Description: Status shows INFO instead of FAIL when ad pixels fire — inconsistent with AUD-004 which auto-detects violations without requiring manual toggle
Root Cause: AUD-005 requires explicit consent-denied toggle ON while AUD-004 does not — inconsistent consent detection logic between audits
Fix Required: Unify consent-denied detection logic across AUD-004 and AUD-005; auto-detect from CMP consent cookie state instead of requiring manual toggle

Bug Description: Missing category column in details table — AUD-004 shows url/provider/category/status but AUD-005 only shows url/provider/status
Root Cause: category field not included in AUD-005 result rendering
Fix Required: Add category column to AUD-005 detail table output

Bug Description: Limited provider detection — only Google Ads detected on NYTimes despite Meta / LiveRamp / Trade Desk typically firing
Root Cause: Provider allowlist in providers.js may be missing entries for many common ad vendors
Fix Required: Expand providers.js with additional ad pixel patterns for Meta / LiveRamp / The Trade Desk / Amazon Ads / Criteo etc.

Bug Description: Extension Clear Cookies + Clear Storage buttons do not fully reset consent state — CMP banner does not reappear after clearing via extension popup
Root Cause: Extension may not be clearing HttpOnly cookies or service worker cache; also BBC CMP is geo-gated so banner only appears in EU/UK regions
Fix Required: Use chrome.browsingData API to clear all cookies including HttpOnly; add service worker cache clear; document that AUD-006 requires EU/UK geo or VPN for BBC

Bug Description: Essential cookies flagged as non-essential — __cf_bm (Cloudflare bot protection) and consentUUID (CMP own cookie) incorrectly listed as pre-consent violations
Root Cause: No whitelist for known essential/security cookies in AUD-006 logic
Fix Required: Add whitelist of known essential cookies (__cf_bm and variants / consentUUID / CookieConsent / OptanonConsent etc.) that are always exempt from pre-consent flagging

Bug Description: Detail table missing classification/category column — only shows name / domain / secure
Root Cause: category field not included in AUD-006 result table rendering
Fix Required: Add category column to AUD-006 detail table

Bug Description: Status shows INFO instead of WARN when third-party domains are detected — any external domain contact warrants at minimum a warning
Root Cause: Status threshold logic treating all third-party domain results as informational
Fix Required: Change status to WARN when 1+ third-party domains detected; FAIL above a configurable threshold (e.g. >10 domains)
